propositions: Ticket directory and CREATE event file are created separately, leaving a race window where an interruption after mkdir but before event write produces orphaned empty directories that fsck flags as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH.

The fix stages directory and first event atomically in a dot-prefixed temporary path (.tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex>) and publishes both via single os.rename under the write lock, making temp paths invisible to existing fsck scanners without code changes.

All store write paths that create a directory before writing the first file (single-event, batch, reconciler event, bridge alert) are converted to use StagedEvent.promote() to eliminate the interrupted-write debris signature.

Stale staging directories from dead processes are swept at writer startup using process-timestamp-based staleness detection, bounded and best-effort, touching only staging areas and never ticket directories or store data.
